title: 국회상임위원회 위원 정수에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00243:20251026:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <National Assembly Regulation No. 243, October 26, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Regulations shall enter into force on November 1, 2025: Provided, That the amended provisions of subparagraph 4 and the amendments to Article 4 (1) 2 of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of the National Assembly Sejong Chamber, made pursuant to Article 2 of these Addenda, shall enter into force on January 2, 2026.

Article 2 (Amendment to Other Regulations)
The Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of the National Assembly Sejong Chamber shall be partially amended as follows:

Article 4 (1) 2 and 10 shall be replaced respectively with the following:

2. Finance, Economy and Planning Committee;
10. Climate, Energy, Environment and Labor Committee.
